headline: Wild jump out 3–0, hand Bruins a second straight home loss
takeaway: Minnesota built a 3–0 lead 2:00 into the second period and never let Boston closer than two in a 6–2 win at TD Garden. The Bruins have lost two straight at home after winning their first seven there.

sections.label: 1st period
sections.text: Ryan Hartman scored from the left circle at 6:54, finishing a give-and-go with Blake Coleman. Jesper Wallstedt stopped David Pastrnak early, and the period ended 4-on-4.

sections.label: 2nd period
sections.text: Quinn Hughes scored from the high slot 53 seconds in, and Coleman's point shot went in off Nikita Zadorov at 2:00 for 3–0. Fraser Minten cut it to 3–1 on a power play at 8:45, set up by Pastrnak from behind the net, and Tanner Jeannot fought Marcus Foligno right after. Hartman restored the three-goal lead on a 3-on-2 at 10:00.

sections.label: 3rd period
sections.text: Pastrnak's snap shot off a Zadorov feed made it 4–2 at 4:45, ending his four-game goal drought, but Danila Yurov answered at 6:15 off a Boston pinch. Yurov added an empty-netter at 15:21. Boston outshot Minnesota 32–25.

performers.name: David Pastrnak
performers.note: Scored his ninth goal of the season in the third and set up Minten's power-play goal.

performers.name: Fraser Minten
performers.note: His seventh of the season cut it to 3–1, but Minnesota scored again 75 seconds later.

performers.name: Jeremy Swayman
performers.note: Allowed five goals two days after being pulled against Montreal; he has given up nine in two games.

oppLine: Ryan Hartman and Danila Yurov scored twice each; Blake Coleman had a goal and two assists, Kirill Kaprizov two assists, and Jesper Wallstedt made 30 saves.
